subject.title: fix(browser): notify agent when click triggers download

question: Should browser click-download feedback be solved by optional `downloads` metadata on `/act` with latest-action page ownership, or should OpenClaw prefer explicit download actions or stricter ownership before merge?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and well-covered, but it changes agent-visible browser API semantics while another open PR proposes a different API shape and the current proof predates the final response shape.

options.title: Land implicit `/act` metadata
options.body: Accept the optional `downloads` array and latest-action ownership contract after the PR body is refreshed with current-head live output.

options.title: Require stricter ownership
options.body: Ask for a code change and focused regression so unrelated overlapping actions cannot receive the triggering action's download metadata.

options.title: Prefer explicit actions
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of a reviewed `download` and `waitfordownload` browser tool action surface.

recommendation.title: Land implicit `/act` metadata
recommendation.body: Accept the optional `downloads` array and latest-action ownership contract after the PR body is refreshed with current-head live output.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on this exact branch and adjacent browser download behavior.
